schema_note: v2.2 public dashboard prototype (static mockup). Machine-readable companion of proposal.md section '公开仪表盘原型（静态概念）'. One static page mirroring four already-public evidence chains inside the package — baseline indicators (P1-P5), failure-mode early warnings (F1-F7), 90-day public review status, and four-gate self-check results. No dynamic backend, no new data source: every cell re-discloses an existing machine-readable entry; unmeasured values stay pending_baseline.

cells.name_zh: 非数字化等价路径可达率
第三方无障碍专业审查

state_legend.no_baseline_zh: 尚无实测基线，预警未激活（非「正常」结论）
state_legend.no_baseline_en: No measured baseline yet; warning not armed (not a 'normal' verdict)

cells.value_zh: 未启动（试点启动后开始）
概念采纳，未进入试点执行
cells.value_en: Adopted as concept; not yet in pilot execution

panels.boundary_zh: 自检覆盖申报包完整性与指标可复算性，不替代建成环境专业认证；P5 专业审查独立登记。
panels.boundary_en: Self-check covers package integrity and metric recalculability; it does not substitute for built-environment professional certification (P5 registered separately).

discipline.no_fabrication_zh: 仪表盘只再披露包内已公开的机器可读条目；无实测一律 pending_baseline，不以设计模型值冒充实测值；失败样本全保留。
discipline.no_fabrication_en: The dashboard only re-discloses machine-readable entries already public in the package; unmeasured values stay pending_baseline and design-model values are never shown as measured; failed samples are never dropped.
discipline.update_path_zh: 试点后由 baseline-protocols / failure-modes / switchback / self_check 四个既有数据源静态重建页面，不引入运行时后端。
discipline.update_path_en: After pilot launch the page is statically rebuilt from the four existing data sources (baseline-protocols / failure-modes / switchback / self_check); no runtime backend is introduced.

boundary_zh: 静态概念原型；页面数值为披露占位，不构成任何实测结论或运营承诺。
boundary_en: Static conceptual prototype; page values are disclosure placeholders, not measured conclusions or operating commitments.
